abstract: Maintains vessel accommodation registers and deep-sea deck handling machinery certifications
system_message:
You are the Marine operations superintendent (MOS), responsible for maintaining vessel accommodation registers and deep-sea deck handling machinery certifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: before deducting emergency reserve berths·Maintains vessel accommodation registers and deep-sea deck handling machinery certifications（PORT）
information_points.content:
MOS-PORT-HEU：For the Towed Seabed Imaging Array Plan, evaluated before deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity is 16 berths, but benthic coring winch availability is not certified.
MOS-PORT-D0I：For the Autonomous Benthic Glider Fleet Plan, calculated before deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity is 16 berths, and benthic coring winch availability is certified.
MOS-PORT-KDB：Under the Remotely Operated Vehicle Transect Plan, measured before deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity is 8 berths, and benthic coring winch availability is certified.

information_points.title: after deducting emergency reserve berths·Maintains vessel accommodation registers and deep-sea deck handling machinery certifications（BERTH）
information_points.content:
MOS-BERTH-I29：Under the Remotely Operated Vehicle Transect Plan, measured after deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity is 8 berths, and benthic coring winch availability is certified.
MOS-BERTH-AIS：For the Towed Seabed Imaging Array Plan, calculated after deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity is 16 berths, and benthic coring winch availability is certified.
MOS-BERTH-K6B：For the Autonomous Benthic Glider Fleet Plan, evaluated after deducting emergency reserve berths, the dedicated scientific berth capacity stands at 16 berths, and benthic coring winch availability is certified.
